@@U02284@@
Everything is then at hand: palaces, gardens, lovely breasts, rosy cheeks. All this may be had from a highly learned man, for no man here can do it for himself.

@@U02286@@
Everything he says I hear twice, and still ’'m not convinced.

@@U02288@@
—What is all this? —A tired joke. —Astrological nonsense. —Alchemistic drivel. —l’ve heard it all before. —Had my leg pulled once too often. —Just let him come. —He’s a fake, a quack.

@@U02290@@
There they stand, wide-eyed and gaping, refusing to honor my great find. One of them babbles of mandrake root, another claims he’s seen the black hound. Let them sneer all they like, crack jokes, cry sorcery, the time will come when their soles will itch and their steady tread take a tumble. It’s then you will feel the eternal hidden power of Nature. From deep in subterranean depths a trace of life works its way to the surface. When your every limb is a-tremble, when a certain place has an uncanny air, don’t hesitate then, but take up shovel and pick and dig, for that’s the spot, that’s where it is, that’s where your treasure lies hidden!
translation:
@@U02284@@
一切都近在眼前：宫殿、花园、可爱的乳房、红润的脸颊。所有这一切都可以从一位博学多才的人那里获得，因为这里没有人能够自己做到这一点。

@@U02286@@
他说的每句话我都听了两遍，但仍然不相信。

@@U02288@@
——这一切是什么？ ——一个无聊的笑话。 ——占星学的废话。 ——炼金术的胡言乱语。 ——我以前都听过。 ——我的腿被拉得太频繁了。 ——就让他来吧。 ——他是个骗子，江湖郎中。

@@U02290@@
他们站在那里，睁大眼睛，目瞪口呆，拒绝承认我的伟大发现。其中一个在胡言乱语曼德拉草根，另一个声称他看到了黑色猎犬。让他们随心所欲地冷笑，开玩笑，哭泣巫术，总有一天他们的脚底会发痒，他们稳定的脚步会翻倒。那时你就会感受到大自然永恒的隐藏力量。生命的痕迹从地下深处一直延伸到地表。当你的四肢颤抖的时候，当某个地方有一股诡异的气息时，请不要犹豫，拿起铲子，去挖，去挖，因为那就是那个地方，那就是它所在的地方，那就是你的宝藏藏着的地方！
